pixel_unit: one exported pixel equals one world unit at scale 1
coordinate_system: x right, y down; anchors are pixel offsets from image top-left

10001-R01.build: Approved native scene plus reflected tile, blended across 64-pixel overlap. Intentional repeated art; not an AI-generated unique panorama or 2K asset.

stump.collision_policy: Suggested XY ground footprint only; not the full upright sprite rectangle; tune in future gameplay integration.

godot4_usage.background: Load room PNG into Sprite2D, centered=false, position=room_origin, scale=(1,1).
godot4_usage.entity: Sprite2D centered=false, offset=-Vector2(anchor[0],anchor[1]); set position to foot world position.
godot4_usage.shadow: Use a sibling Sprite2D with shadow offset=-shadow.anchor, same foot world position, drawn below entity.
godot4_usage.collision: Attach RectangleShape2D using the footprint relative to the entity foot position; game behavior is not included.
godot4_usage.paths: Copy this self-contained export package under the future game's resource directory and resolve files relative to manifest. Current game has no automatic reader for this schema.
godot4_usage.zoom: Do not resize only texture without scaling anchors/collision/placement consistently. This batch is low-resolution, not a native 2K delivery.
